gaps.explanation: Statement lines come from the accrual Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Change in Net Position - Proprietary Funds (p6, printed p8): User fees 547,555 + Other 1,287 = 548,842. The business-type schedule is the Budgetary Basis Budget and Actual - Proprietary Fund (p10, printed p20): User fees 553,019 + Other 1,287 = Total receipts 554,306. Difference 554,306 - 548,842 = 5,464 is exactly '(In)decrease accounts receivable 5,464' on the proprietary Statement of Cash Flows (p7): cash collected exceeds accrual revenue. Both totals printed as recorded; nothing missing or doubled.

Statement (p6, accrual): Utility operations 411,837 + Depreciation 95,716 + Debt service - interest 11,746 = 519,299. Budgetary-basis schedule (p10): DISBURSEMENTS 363,619 (one printed line, detail 43), with Debt service (160,000) under other financing (detail 44). The schedule excludes depreciation 95,716 and is on a cash/budgetary basis (p7 adjustments: accounts payable 3,059, accrued liabilities 2,657, equipment 54,248); the statement is accrual. Printed totals 519,299 vs 363,619 genuinely differ (statement above by 155,680); the single disbursements line has no breakdown to reconcile.
